name: Dinn Rig
text: Dinn Rig, also spelled Dinnrigh, is treated by the dictionary as a variant spelling of Dind Rig. The form appears in Irish literature and scholarship for the royal fort on the Barrow River near Leighlinbridge. Readers looking for the political and legendary material should consult the Dind Rig entry. The fuller entry there sets out the connection to the south Leinster kings and to Orgain Denna Rig. Other variant spellings of the same place are Dinnrigh, Dinrigh, and Duma Sláinge. All forms point to the same earthworks in County Carlow.
